name: Nextcloud All-in-One
description: Your own cloud for files, calendars and contacts, with office documents, video calls and backups built in.

volumes.description: AIO's own settings; its backups need exactly this volume name

notes: Nextcloud is set up from the AIO interface: open it, accept its self-signed certificate, write down the passphrase it shows, and follow its steps. Nextcloud itself needs a domain name that points to this computer, with port 443 (and 3478 for Talk) reachable from the internet; AIO supports neither IP addresses nor self-signed certificates for it. AIO then creates and updates its own nextcloud-aio-* containers: they count as part of this app, and uninstalling stops and removes them. Their data volumes are kept unless you also delete the data.
